PanelDescription.SourceString: 刚收到奇怪的广告，白藏就发来了消息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I just got a strange ad, and then Baicang messaged me…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往和白藏约定的地点，一起调查这个古怪的逆天改命事务所吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the meeting spot you agreed on with Baicang and investigate Fate Rewriters together

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和白藏约好了一起做养花的准备工作，去集山忘野和他汇合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You and Baicang agreed to prepare for growing flowers together. Head to Hillside Blooms and meet up with him.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>桥间地喷泉广场</>与白藏、小布妮会面
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Bridge Crossings Fountain Plaza</> to meet Baicang and Little Buni

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏想要理解小布妮说的话，去喷泉广场帮他现场翻译一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang wants to understand what Little Buni is saying. Head to the Fountain Plaza and help translate for him.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait to depart the next day (<blue>14:00–16:00</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好好休息，期待明天的郊游吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Get some rest and look forward to tomorrow's outing!

Description.SourceString: 前往海边公路的<blue>2-Four便利店</>与白藏汇合
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>2-Four Convenience Store</> on the Coastal Road and meet up with Baicang

PanelDescription.SourceString: 白藏和小布妮正在海边的2-Four便利店等待，和他们汇合然后出发吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Baicang and Little Buni are waiting at the 2-Four Convenience Store by the seaside. Meet up with them and head out!

Description.SourceString: 驾驶白藏的车去往<blue>花田</>
Description.LocalizedString: Drive Baicang's car to the <blue>Flower Field</>

Description.SourceString: 驾驶白藏的车去往<blue>花田</>
Description.LocalizedString: Drive Baicang's car to the <blue>flower field</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然发生了一些小插曲，但开车兜风总是愉快的。驾车去往花田吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There was a small hiccup along the way, but a drive is always a good time. Let's head to the Flower Field.

Description.SourceString: 在花田中与<blue>小布妮</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Little Buni</> in the Flower Field

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这片花田很像是小布妮所说的家园，和白藏一起陪它确认一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This Flower Field seems a lot like the home Little Buni mentioned. Let's go with Baicang and help them check it out.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>灵可</>在约定地点会合
Description.LocalizedString: Meet with <blue>Linko</> at the rendezvous point

PanelDescription.SourceString: 灵可声称自己找到了外星人，还发来了一起调查的邀请，去看看是怎么回事吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Linko claims she found aliens and invited you to investigate with her. Go see what's going on.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>灵可</>商讨诱捕外星人的计划
Description.LocalizedString: Work out a plan with <blue>Linko</> to lure the aliens out

PanelDescription.SourceString: 灵可对外星人的存在深信不疑，还计划将它们引诱出来……总之陪她玩一会儿吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Linko's absolutely convinced aliens are real, and she's even planning to draw them out of hiding… might as well humor her for a bit.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Close Encounter of the Fourth Kind?!

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>灵可</>回到约定地点，准备诱捕外星人
Description.LocalizedString: Head back to the rendezvous point with <blue>Linko</> and prepare to lure out the aliens

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然几乎毫无道理，但计划已经进展了这一步……和灵可一起，用牛奶诱捕外星人吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It makes absolutely no sense, but we've already gotten this far… Team up with Linko and use milk to bait the aliens!

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>旧电器店</>，与灵可会合
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Old Electronics Store</> and meet up with Linko

PanelDescription.SourceString: 灵可的电视机发生了一些意外，小贞从那之后就没有出现过……去看看灵可的情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Linko's TV ran into some trouble, and Xiaozhen hasn't shown up since… Go check on Linko.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩</>与<blue>塔吉多</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 布朗老爹没法修好电视，但好在伊波恩有一位对电视钻研颇深的维修专家……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Old Brown couldn't fix the TV, but luckily, Eibon has a repair expert who really knows his stuff…

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>伊波恩后院</>，查看塔吉多的情况
Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Eibon's Backyard</> and check on Taygedo

PanelDescription.SourceString: 后院居然传出了塔吉多的悲鸣，去看看发生了什么吧，希望獭没事……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo's cries are coming from the backyard. Go investigate.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>上晴塔餐厅</>，与灵可交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Hethereau Skytower Dining Room</> and talk to Linko

PanelDescription.SourceString: 灵可想向你介绍一位来自宇宙的朋友，去和她谈谈吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Linko wishes to introduce you to a friend from outer space. Go speak with her.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>上晴塔塔顶</>，等待彗星经过
Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>Hethereau Skytower Rooftop</> and wait for the comet to pass by

PanelDescription.SourceString: 星与星的距离太过遥远，但电波能够跨越亿万光年的真空，让你我相连。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The stars are far apart, but frequencies can span billions of light-years, connecting you and me.
